sources.title: SmolLM2-135M · Models
sources.snippet: Model Summary SmolLM2 is a family of compact language models available in three size: 135M, 360M, and 1.7B parameters. They are capable of solving a wide range of tasks while being lightweight enough to run on-device. SmolLM2 demonstrates significant advances over its predecessor SmolLM1, particularly in instruction following, knowledge, reasoning.

sources.snippet: We evaluate and compare the final base SmolLM2 model with existing state-of-the-art models of similar size, Qwen2.5-1.5B (Yang et al. 2024b) and Llama3.2-1B (AI@Meta 2024a), on a wide range of benchmarks.

sources.snippet: SmolLM2 Relevant source files SmolLM2 is a family of compact language models designed for on-device usage and efficiency-focused applications. This page covers the SmolLM2 model family, including the 135M, 360M, and 1.7B parameter variants, their training methodologies, and integration patterns within the broader SmolLM ecosystem.
